title: Local RAG Pipeline with ChromaDB and Sentence Transformers
title_es: Pipeline RAG local con ChromaDB y Sentence Transformers
description: Complete local RAG pipeline: document chunking with overlap, ChromaDB persistent vector store, sentence-transformers embeddings, OpenAI or Ollama generation, and optional cross-encoder reranking.
description_es: Pipeline RAG local completo: chunking de documentos con overlap, store vectorial persistente con ChromaDB, embeddings con sentence-transformers, generacion con OpenAI u Ollama y reranking opcional con cross-encoder.
